```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
nb_id <- "20260212"
here::i_am(paste0("notebooks/", nb_id, ".qmd"))

library(R.matlab)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(gt)
library(here)

# knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root_dir)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, warning = F, message = F)

source(here("R", "preprocessing.R"))
t2_dir <- here("data", "raw", "lee2024", "data", "textures2_data")

out_dir <- paste0(here("data", "processed"), "/", nb_id, "/")
res_dir <- paste0(here("results"), "/", nb_id, "/")

if (!dir.exists(res_dir)) dir.create(res_dir)

theme_set(theme_minimal())
theme_replace(axis.title = element_text(size = 9))
```

## Data

```{r file names, eval = F}
files <- list.files(t2_dir)

out_subdirs <- paste0(
  out_dir, 
  c("session_info", "stimuli", "recordings"), "/")

dummy <- lapply(
  out_subdirs, 
  function(x) if (!dir.exists(x)) dir.create(x)
)

silent <- FALSE
recordings <- lapply(
  files, 
  function(f) {
    f_details <- file_info(f)
    if (!silent) 
      message(
        "Reading ", f_details$region, " (",
        f_details$age, " wks, ", 
        f_details$n_subjects, " subjects)..."
      )
    
    matlab <- R.matlab::readMat(paste0(t2_dir, f))
    stims <- clean_stimuli(matlab)
    firings <- matlab$bins
    rm(matlab)

    # write info
    # f_name <- paste0(
    #   f_details$region, "_", 
    #   f_details$age, "wk_", 
    #   f_details$n_subjects)
    f_name <- paste0(f_details$region, "_", f_details$age, "wk")
    stim_f <- paste0(out_subdirs[2], f_name, ".csv")
    neur_f <- paste0(out_subdirs[3], f_name, ".rds")
    write.csv(stims, stim_f)
    saveRDS(firings, neur_f)

    f_details$stimuli_file <- stim_f
    f_details$recordings_file <- neur_f
    
    if (!silent) message("Saving ", f_name)
    write.table(
      yaml::as.yaml(f_details), 
      paste0(out_subdirs[1], f_name, ".yaml"), 
      quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F)
  }
)
```

```{r}
v1_info <- yaml::read_yaml(paste0(out_subdirs[1], "V1_29wk.yaml"))
```

## Average firings

```{r}
N_ARRAY <- 96
v_list <- v1
noise_idx <- which(v_list$stim$coherence == 1)
struc_idx <- which(v_list$stim$coherence == 2)
n_channels <- v_list$info$n_subjects * N_ARRAY

rcrd_dt <- lapply(1:n_channels, function(x) {
  tempmat <- v_list$rcrd[, , x]
  if (mean(is.na(tempmat)) > 0.999) {
    # message("Channel ", x, " is empty.")
    return()
  }
  temp <- data.table(tempmat)
  colnames(temp) <- paste0("bin", 1:ncol(temp))
  temp$channel <- x
  temp$stimulus <- 1:nrow(temp)
  dt <- melt(temp, id.vars = c("channel", "stimulus"), variable.name = "bin", value.name = "spikes")
  dt$bin <- as.numeric(gsub(pattern = "bin", x = dt$bin, replacement = ""))
  dt
})
rcrd_dt <- do.call(rbind, rcrd_dt)
# fam_avg <- rcrd_dt[ , lapply(.(), sum)]
```

```{r}
v4 <- readRDS(paste0(out_dir, "V4_29wk_2s.RDS"))
keep_idx <- which(stims$coherence > 0)
grps <- stims[keep_idx, "coherence"]
flat <- apply(firings[keep_idx, , ], c(1, 2), mean, na.rm = T)
v4_df <- apply_rowgroups(
  flat, grps$coherence, mean, na.rm = T
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(coherence = unique(grps$coherence)) %>%
  gather("time", "firing", -coherence) %>%
  mutate(time = as.integer(gsub("X", "", time)))

v4_df %>%
  filter(time %in% times) %>%
  mutate(time = (time - onset_time)) %>%
  mutate(Image = ifelse(
    coherence == 1, 
    "Noise", "Naturalistic"), 
    region = region_names[x]
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-avg_firings
#| fig-cap: "Average firing rate over images with naturalistic (red) or noise (blue) structure, separated by region in the visual cortex. In general, later visual regions (V4, IT) tend to show more divergence than early visual regions."
recordings <- readRDS("data/processed/20260206/recordings.RDS")
noise_vs_structure <- do.call(rbind, recordings)
p <- noise_vs_structure %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("V1", "FC", "V2", "V4", "IT"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = firing, color = Image)) + 
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      x = "Time after stimulus (ms)", 
      y = "Average firing"
    )
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "noise_vs_structure.png"), p, width = 9, height = 2.5)
```
